info.title: Joomla 5.4.8 com_media REST contract
info.description: Source-pinned API knowledge. Examples are synthetic; no runtime requests.

200.description: Пример формы ответа по реализации; не live acceptance.

get.x-pagination: No standard page slicing: the specialized model/view returns all retrieved items or its own search result batch. Do not infer 20-item pagination from the generic controller.
get.description:
path включает адаптер, например local-images:/example.webp; ID адаптера — данные сайта.
GET files/{path}/ с завершающим / возвращает список, без / — элемент.
POST требует path; для файла нужен base64 content, для папки content отсутствует.
POST override по умолчанию false; PATCH override по умолчанию true: для запрета
перезаписи явно передавать false. В PATCH path тела — новый путь, URL path — старый.
Нужен хотя бы path или content. Не передавать multipart, data: URL или сырые байты.
Лимиты размера, допустимые MIME/расширения и возможности определяются настройками
и адаптером. content/url/tempUrl в ответе условны.
Для снимка 5.4.8 не переносить правила PATCH/ACL и новые поля из 6.2.0. Пропущенные календарные колонки могут повторно пройти UTC-фильтр; после записи сравнивать даты.

upload_maxsize.x-input-normalization: Joomla form accepts integer or decimal integer string; optional empty string is form-filter dependent.
upload_maxsize.title: Maximum Size (in MB)
upload_maxsize.description: Use zero for no limit. Note: your server has a maximum limit.

file_path.title: Path to Files Folder
file_path.description: Enter the path to the files folder relative to the root of your webspace. Warning! Changing to another path than the default 'images' may break your links. Note: Do not start the path with a slash!

image_path.title: Path to Images Folder
image_path.description: Enter the path to the images folder relative to the root of your webspace. This path has to be the same as path to files (default) or to a subfolder of the path to file folder. Note: Do not start the path with a slash!

restrict_uploads.x-input-normalization: Joomla form accepts integer or decimal integer string; optional empty string is form-filter dependent.
restrict_uploads.title: Restrict Uploads
restrict_uploads.description: Restrict uploads for lower than manager users to images if Fileinfo or MIME Magic isn't installed.

restrict_uploads_extensions.title: Allowed Extensions
restrict_uploads_extensions.description: Restrict uploads for lower than manager users to files in the list.

check_mime.x-input-normalization: Joomla form accepts integer or decimal integer string; optional empty string is form-filter dependent.

check_mime.description: Use MIME Magic or Fileinfo to attempt to verify files. Try disabling this if you get invalid mime type errors.

image_extensions.title: Legal Image Extensions (File Types)
image_extensions.description: Image extensions (file types) you are allowed to upload (comma separated). These are used to check for valid image headers.

audio_extensions.title: Legal Audio Extensions (File Types)
audio_extensions.description: Audio extensions (file types) you are allowed to upload (comma separated). These are used to check for valid audio headers.

video_extensions.title: Legal Video Extensions (File Types)
video_extensions.description: Video extensions (file types) you are allowed to upload (comma separated). These are used to check for valid video headers.

doc_extensions.title: Legal Document Extensions (File Types)
doc_extensions.description: Document extensions (file types) you are allowed to upload (comma separated). These are used to check for valid document headers.

ignore_extensions.title: Ignored Extensions
ignore_extensions.description: Ignored file extensions for MIME type checking and restricted uploads.

upload_mime.title: Legal MIME Types
